WIENXTRA Kinderaktiv

Target group: families and children; age ranges vary by event. Content: year-round free or low-cost culture, sport, nature, games and creative activities across Vienna.

Dates/locations: updated monthly; the official calendar can be filtered by age, date, location and free events. Contact: WIENXTRA-Kinderaktiv, Lassallestraße 3, 1020 Vienna · kinderaktiv@wienxtra.at.

WIENXTRA Ferienspiel

Age: 6–13. Content: school-holiday games, crafts, discovery, theatre, cinema, museums, sport and action; many activities are free or discounted.

Dates/locations: during winter, semester and summer holidays across Vienna. Contact: WIENXTRA-Ferienspiel, Lassallestraße 3, 1020 Vienna · +43 1 909 4000 84396 · ferienspiel@wienxtra.at.

Vienna Libraries – children’s programme

Age: 0–14. Content: year-round children’s and youth events including readings, music, creative, language and discovery activities.

Dates/locations: across Vienna Libraries branches according to the continuously updated events calendar. Contact: Urban-Loritz-Platz 2a, 1070 Vienna · +43 1 4000-84500 · bib.auskunft@buechereien.wien.gv.at.
